command: Extend gemmini_descriptor_sequencer from the passing single-tile INT8 OS GEMM subset to the already-audited retained-Rocket operations in this order: multi-tile OS, LOOP_WS, convolution, bias, then requant/ReLU. Reuse the frozen Python encoders and exact retained-Rocket transcripts as generated expected vectors; keep descriptor fetch pre-issue validation and busy-clear completion unchanged. Run every build/test with taskset -c 8-25, at most j4, only when MemAvailable exceeds 10 GiB.
success_condition: Every required production typed-descriptor case emits the same CUSTOM_3 funct/rs1/rs2 sequence as its pinned official path, rejects unsupported/incomplete records before issue, and preserves bit-exact retained-Rocket output/write/event traces. Then L2 can be audited for PASS and formal L3 integration can close.
failure_policy: Stop at the first protocol/numerical mismatch. Do not bypass Shared L2, substitute pre-lowered host micro-ops, use io_resp as completion, loosen descriptor legality, or mark L2/L3 PASS before their remaining canonical gates close. Do not run Library Compiler or LEF generation while deferred by the user.
